title: phocal / OT Gateway
description: OT Gateway telemetry (Effect OTLP -> Grafana Cloud). Source: ot-gateway/observability/grafana/ot-gateway.dashboard.ts

panels.title: Devices reporting
panels.description: Devices that completed at least one successful cycle in the range. Counted per site, building and device, so a gateway upgrade (a new service.version) does not count its devices twice.

targets.expr: count(max by (site, building, device) (max_over_time(ot_gateway_device_last_success_timestamp_seconds{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Stalest device
panels.description: Seconds since the device that has gone longest without a successful cycle last succeeded. Uses the last value in the range, so a stopped gateway turns red instead of disappearing.

targets.expr: max(time() - max by (site, building, device) (max_over_time(ot_gateway_device_last_success_timestamp_seconds{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__range])))

sum(rate(ot_gateway_poll_cycles_total{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device", outcome="ok"}[$__range])) / sum(rate(ot_gateway_poll_cycles_total{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Read failures (range)
panels.description: Cycles whose device read still failed after retries.

targets.expr: sum(increase(ot_gateway_read_failures_total{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

sum(increase(ot_gateway_publish_failures_total{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Cycle p95
panels.description: Includes driver retries and publishing.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(ot_gateway_poll_duration_seconds_bucket{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Cycles by outcome
panels.description: timed_out: a cycle hung past the device's cycleTimeoutMs (a device or the broker side that never answers) and was abandoned.

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) (rate(ot_gateway_poll_cycles_total{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Read failures by device and reason

targets.expr: sum by (device, reason) (rate(ot_gateway_read_failures_total{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Cycle duration p50 / p95 by device

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (device, le) (rate(ot_gateway_poll_duration_seconds_bucket{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (device, le) (rate(ot_gateway_poll_duration_seconds_bucket{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Values published vs held back (change mode)
panels.description: Messages published, against reads that change mode held back. Sample and aggregate points never hold back; a sample interval or an aggregate window publishes fewer messages than reads.

targets.expr: sum(rate(ot_gateway_values_published_total{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum(rate(ot_gateway_values_suppressed_total{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]))

time() - max by (device) (ot_gateway_device_last_success_timestamp_seconds{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"})

panels.title: Device requests by outcome
panels.description: Every request a driver sent. exception = the device refused (check the point address); timeout and connection = it is unreachable.

targets.expr: sum by (device, outcome) (rate(ot_gateway_driver_requests_total{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Connections opened by device
panels.description: A healthy link connects once. Repeated ok connects mean it keeps dropping; failed means it cannot connect. $bacnet is the one UDP socket every BACnet device shares.

targets.expr: sum by (device, outcome) (increase(ot_gateway_driver_connects_total{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Pipeline restarts by device
panels.description: A device's pipeline died on a bug (a defect, not a device or broker failure) and was restarted with backoff, up to every 5 minutes. Any restart is a bug to report; the gateway log has the cause. Other devices keep running.

targets.expr: sum by (device) (increase(ot_gateway_device_restarts_total{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Device refusals by exception
panels.description: Reads a device refused, after retries. illegal_data_address on every cycle means a point address is wrong; busy and gateway exceptions come and go. The log has one warning when a refusal starts, not one per cycle.

targets.expr: sum by (device, exception) (increase(ot_gateway_driver_refusals_total{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Mean request time by device
panels.description: How long one request takes, from sending (and connecting, if need be) to the answer. A slow device or Modbus gateway shows here; a cycle that is slow because it sends many requests does not. Timeouts count at their full length.

targets.expr: sum by (device) (rate(ot_gateway_driver_request_seconds_total{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (device) (rate(ot_gateway_driver_requests_total{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Connected to the MQTT broker
panels.description: 1 while the gateway holds a broker connection. While it is 0, values go to the store-and-forward buffer if one is configured, and are lost otherwise.

targets.expr: max by (service_instance_id) (ot_gateway_mqtt_connected{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"})

panels.title: Broker connection attempts by outcome
panels.description: A healthy gateway connects once. Repeated ok means the connection keeps dropping; failed means the broker is unreachable; rejected means it refused (check credentials).

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) (increase(ot_gateway_mqtt_connects_total{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Commands by outcome
panels.description: Commands received on site/building/device/point/$set. written reached the device; rejected was refused by the command guard (not writable, out of range, wrong type, retained, expired after waiting too long) and never reached it; failed could not be written (device down, refused, no answer); dropped arrived while too many were already waiting (a flood) and got no result.

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) (increase(ot_gateway_commands_total{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Rejected and failed commands by reason
panels.description: Why commands did not get through. retained on every reconnect means a retained message sits on a $set topic: clear it on the broker. Every command is also in the logs.

targets.expr: sum by (outcome, reason) (increase(ot_gateway_commands_total{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device", outcome!="written"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Messages waiting in the buffer
panels.description: Rows in the SQLite outbox. It grows during a broker outage and falls back to 0 once the gateway has delivered them. A line that stays above 0 while the broker is connected means draining is stuck.

targets.expr: max by (service_instance_id) (ot_gateway_buffer_rows{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"})

panels.title: Buffer traffic
panels.description: Stored during an outage, delivered after it. Dropped means data was lost: overflow when the outbox passed buffer.maxRows, rejected when the broker refused a stored message, unreadable when a stored row no longer decoded, undeliverable when a row broke the connection three times in a row, lost when the buffer file was corrupt or replaced.

targets.expr: sum(increase(ot_gateway_buffer_written_total{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum(increase(ot_gateway_buffer_drained_total{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (reason) (increase(ot_gateway_buffer_dropped_total{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Buffer store failures
panels.description: Failed SQLite operations on the outbox (a full disk, a busy or broken file). While inserts fail, live values go straight to the broker instead (published past the buffer); while deletes fail, delivered rows are remembered in memory and not sent again.

targets.expr: sum by (operation) (increase(ot_gateway_buffer_failures_total{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum(increase(ot_gateway_buffer_bypassed_total{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Running without a buffer
panels.description: 1 while the buffer file cannot be opened, so values published during a broker outage are lost. The gateway retries every 30 seconds; the error log says why.

targets.expr: max by (service_instance_id) (ot_gateway_buffer_disabled{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"})

panels.title: Device freshness
panels.description: Seconds since each device last completed a successful cycle. Orange after 1 minute, red after 5. There is no per-point age (one series per point would not fit the free plan); a point that stops reading inside a working device shows in Points not read and in the log.

targets.expr: time() - max by (device) (max_over_time(ot_gateway_device_last_success_timestamp_seconds{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Points not read by device
panels.description: Points a device did not deliver, by reason. refused: it answered without a value (unknown object or property, a value that is not a number). not_finite: the value was NaN or Infinity, also after scaling, and was not published. The gateway log names each point once when it starts and stops failing. not_read: the device stopped answering or was busy partway through a cycle, so the rest waited for the next one. A device that does not answer at all is counted under read failures, not per point.

targets.expr: sum by (device, reason) (increase(ot_gateway_point_read_failures_total{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Values pushed by device
panels.description: Values devices sent on their own between polls (BACnet change-of-value notifications), before the publish mode. Each subscription also sends its current value when it is made or renewed.

targets.expr: sum by (device) (increase(ot_gateway_pushed_readings_total{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Points pushed instead of polled
panels.description: Points kept up to date by a live change-of-value subscription, which the polling cycle skips. A drop means the device refused or stopped sending notifications, and those points are polled again.

targets.expr: max by (device) (ot_gateway_pushed_points{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building", device=~"$device"})

panels.title: Gateway memory
panels.description: Resident memory (rss) and V8 heap in use. Both should level off within an hour of a start; a steady climb over days is a leak.

targets.expr: max by (service_instance_id, kind) (ot_gateway_process_memory_bytes{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building"})

panels.title: Event loop lag
panels.description: The worst event-loop delay of the last minute. Every device, keepalive and deadline shares the loop: a p99 above 50 ms on a Pi is worth a look, a max above 1 s is logged as a stall.

targets.expr: max by (service_instance_id, quantile) (ot_gateway_event_loop_lag_seconds{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building"})

panels.title: Gateway CPU
panels.description: Share of one CPU core the gateway process uses, user and system time together.

targets.expr: sum by (service_instance_id) (rate(ot_gateway_process_cpu_seconds_total{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: SoC temperature
panels.description: The first thermal zone. A Raspberry Pi 4 starts throttling at 80 °C; the log warns at 80 °C.

targets.expr: max by (service_instance_id) (ot_gateway_host_temperature_celsius{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building"})

panels.title: Power and thermal conditions (Raspberry Pi)
panels.description: What the Raspberry Pi firmware reports: under_voltage (a weak power supply or cable, the most common cause of SD corruption), frequency_capped, throttled, soft_temperature_limit. On Raspberry Pi kernel 6.12 and later only under_voltage (the kernel shows no more); empty off a Pi.

targets.expr: max by (service_instance_id, condition) (max_over_time(ot_gateway_host_throttled{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Outbox disk free
panels.description: Free space on the filesystem that holds the store-and-forward outbox. The log warns below 64 MiB.

targets.expr: min by (service_instance_id) (ot_gateway_buffer_disk_free_bytes{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building"})

panels.title: Storage writes
panels.description: Bytes the gateway writes to storage: what wears an SD card. Near zero while the broker is up (the outbox is only written during outages), high while it buffers.

targets.expr: sum by (service_instance_id) (rate(ot_gateway_process_disk_written_bytes_total{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Open files
panels.description: File descriptors the gateway holds, sockets included. Flat in a healthy gateway; a slow climb is a leak.

targets.expr: max by (service_instance_id) (ot_gateway_process_open_fds{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building"})

panels.title: Wall-clock steps
panels.description: NTP setting the time of a machine without a real-time clock: normal once after boot. Timestamps jump with each step; deadlines and backoffs do not, they use the monotonic clock.

targets.expr: sum by (service_instance_id, direction) (increase(ot_gateway_clock_steps_total{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Gateways: version and start
panels.description: Which build each gateway runs, and when it last started. A start time that keeps changing is a gateway that restarts.

targets.expr: max by (service_instance_id, version, node) (ot_gateway_process_start_time_seconds{service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment", site=~"$site", building=~"$building"}) * 1000
{service_name="ot-gateway", service_namespace="ot-gateway", deployment_environment=~"$environment"} | detected_level=~"warn|error|fatal"

panels.title: Failed polling cycles (traces)
panels.description: Device.pollCycle spans annotated with ot_gateway.outcome. Click a trace ID for the span and its logs.
